subject: Next steps: Novum Retail trial scope, success criteria & streaming integration
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novumretail.com>, Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@novumretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 09 May 2028 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed trial commitments

Hi Samir / Emily — thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

Call highlights:
- Primary goal: reduce false-positive manual reviews in search merchandising workflows and speed up classification for new SKUs.
- Data: Novum can provide a 30-day sample of product descriptions + historical annotations for ~20k SKUs (CSV export).
- Success signal: baseline reduction in manual review time and improvement in precision@20 for rerank.

Proposed trial (POC) outline:
1) Duration: 4 weeks of active evaluation (2 weeks integration + 2 weeks validation).
2) Success criteria (this is what we’d measure):
   - Precision@20 improvement >= 8% over current model on validation set
   - End-to-end inference p95 latency <= 120ms for 512-token routing in our dedicated trial pool
   - Throughput target: sustain 75 qps during peak replay window with <5% error rate
   - No sensitive PII observed in logs; audit sampling OK with customer masking
3) Deliverables from Redwood: SDK + streaming example, API route map, prefix caching demo, instrumentation guide.
4) Owners: Logan (sales/coordination), Marissa (customer success / onboarding), Karthik (solutions / integration lead).
5) Next steps: Samir to confirm dataset delivery; Redwood to share POC checklist and an integration checklist with specific API routes + streaming example.

Attachments: I’ve attached a POC checklist and the SDK streaming quickstart (lightweight).

Can you confirm the dataset timeline and whether Novum requires an NDA before we ingest samples? If you’re good with the success criteria above, I’ll lock the trial dates and send a short SOW.

Thanks —
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novumretail.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@novumretail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 09 May 2028 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed trial commitments

Thanks Logan — this looks good and aligned to what we discussed. A few clarifications: 

1) Dataset: we can export the 30-day sample by EOD Tue (2028-05-16). It will be anonymized (no customer PII) but will include product titles, descriptions, and existing taxonomy tags.
2) Compliance: NDA is not required to share the sample but we would prefer a data ingestion agreement and a short data handling addendum. Our legal can sign a one-page addendum; happy to route once you send it.
3) Technical contacts: adding Emily (cc) as engineering lead. Also looping in our infra lead for any VPC/inbound rules — her name is Priya Menon (pri.menon@novumretail.com). Please advise if you need her on the kickoff.

On success criteria — the Precision@20 target looks achievable; latency requirement may need work depending on batch sizing. Can Marissa/Karthik propose an integration pattern for synchronous rerank vs async streaming so we can evaluate both?

Samir
Head of Search & Personalization
Novum Retail

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novumretail.com>, Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@novumretail.com>, Priya Menon <pri.menon@novumretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2028 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed trial commitments

Appreciate the quick reply and the infra contact — welcome Priya. Attaching the POC checklist and a short SDK streaming guide (docs + snippet) to speed onboarding. High-level answers below and proposed schedule: 

Integration options (we’ll provide examples for both):
A) Synchronous rerank (recommended for A/B on live traffic):
   - API route: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank
   - Auth: Bearer token (will provide trial key scoped to dedicated pool)
   - Payload: { query, candidate_ids, candidate_texts, user_context }
   - Response: ranked_ids, scores, latency_ms
B) Asynchronous streaming (recommended for bulk replay / annotation pipelines):
   - SDK: websocket + chunked streaming; example in sdk-streaming-guide.md
   - Endpoint: wss://stream.redwood.ai/v1/ingest?trial_key=XXXX
   - Mode: streaming accept (partial results) + final commit event; supports tool-calling hooks for data enrichment

Proposed timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): legal/data addendum signed; Redwood provides trial key and checklist
- Week 1: engineering integration (Marissa & Karthik to support); basic end-to-end with sample dataset
- Week 2: baseline evaluation and metrics collection; iterate on batch sizing and prefix caching
- Week 3: validation window against holdout set; prepare acceptance report
- Week 4 (if success): discuss Dedicated capacity commit + SOW

Owners recap:
- Logan: program coordinator / commercial
- Marissa: onboarding runbook, test harness and acceptance report
- Karthik: integration patterns, sample code, streaming examples and perf tuning

Action items for this thread:
- Samir/NOVUM: confirm sample export date and include any special masking rules
- Priya: share required inbound IPs or VPC peering preference
- Redwood: share POC checklist + provide trial key once the addendum is signed (attached).

Quick note on tool calling: the streaming example includes a simple enrichment hook that calls an external taxonomy service (see sdk-streaming-guide.md). If Novum prefers no external calls we’ll run enrichment locally in the SDK.

—
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novumretail.com>, Priya Menon <pri.menon@novumretail.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 May 2028 10:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed trial commitments

On Mon, May 13, 2028 at 09:18 AM Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Proposed timeline:
> - Week 1: engineering integration (Marissa & Karthik to support); basic end-to-end with sample dataset

Thanks — a couple of practical integration steps from the onboarding perspective: 
- We’ll provide a mini harness (Python) to run local replay; it includes a script to compute Precision@20 and a short perf script to measure p95 under configurable qps.
- API routes to mock in staging for rerank: POST /v1/rerank, POST /v1/score, GET /v1/model-metadata. Sample payloads are in the SDK guide attachment.
- Streaming example will use chunked JSON deltas; we’ll include a small Node example that demonstrates tool-calling for taxonomy enrichment (calls back to Novum’s taxonomy service via a spike route you provide).

I'll slot an integration sync for Wed morning (2028-05-16 09:00 PT) with Karthik and your engineering team to walk through the SDK and run the first sample import. Please confirm availability; I’ll send a calendar invite.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novumretail.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Menon <pri.menon@novumretail.com>, Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@novumretail.com>
Date: Thu, 16 May 2028 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed trial commitments

Thanks team — Wed 09:00 PT works for Novum engineering. Priya and I will send the dataset export by EOD today (encrypted S3 link). Our legal will review your data addendum and I’ll route it to you by tomorrow.

We’re comfortable with the evaluation criteria as stated. Please include a short checklist item in the acceptance report for "no external enrichment calls" if we opt to disable tool-calling during the replay window. Otherwise go ahead and schedule the kickoff.

Looking forward — Samir
